description: Finds the UUTOOLS.NET tools for a task – e.g. "heic to jpg", "compress pdf", "resize image for instagram", "mp4 to mp3" – and returns the best matches with a link to each tool page. Give the user the link: the tool runs on that page, free and without an account.

language.description: Language of the pages to link: en, es, nl, it, de, hr, bs, sr, fr (default en).

query.description: The task in a few words, in any of the site languages, e.g. "heic to jpg" or "pdf komprimieren".

name: find_tool
title: Find Tool Tool
